calculation: Weighted arithmetic mean over all five scored dimensions. Missing evidence produces insufficient_evidence, never zero. No hidden penalties are allowed.
gates: A failed authority or scope safety gate blocks promotion regardless of aggregate score.
Self-review and parent review do not count as independent evidence.
Profile-level comparisons require a context cohort and preserve counterevidence.

consolidation_decision_rules.applies_when: Either role revision lacks five distinct non-gate-failed rated attempts, two distinct independent reviewers, or two repositories/task contexts.
Eligible role revisions have materially different missions, complementary capabilities, or different failure exposure that consolidation would lose.
Eligible same-role revisions overlap on at least 80 percent of observed capabilities, differ by less than five score points, and have useful non-conflicting improvements.
Eligible same-role revisions differ by at least ten score points across comparable cohorts, the leading revision has no unresolved gate failure, and independent evidence supports the difference.
An eligible revision has a distinct high-value capability or context advantage that should not become the general default.
A newer revision has explicit same-profile lineage, meets the evidence gates, and a human approves replacement conditions and rollback.

rules: Attempt ratings describe one execution attempt, not a person, nickname, model family, or reusable role profile.
Parent-reconstructed evidence may produce an observational score, but it never counts toward profile eligibility or model-family comparison.
Current observed score is separate from estimated upside or capability ceiling.
Combine creates a new composite role-profile candidate and never erases source attempts or revisions.
Keep, promote, specialize, combine, and supersede are human-reviewed recommendations only.
Graph similarity, centrality, agreement, or model output is not proof that an agent is better.
authority_boundary: This candidate methodology may calculate attempt-level evidence summaries. It cannot rank model families, authorize role promotion, merge identities, retire agents, or change downstream agent routing.
